about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Vigil of Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: May the outpouring of the Holy Spirit cleanse our hearts, O Lord, and make them fruitful by the inward sprinkling of His dew. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the same Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.
